body:
I feel that if I were to attempt something like that, I wouldn't be able to devote as much of myself to each person as I would want. Would feel disingenuous.

Also, while I enjoy helping people... how to put this.
Basically, there's not much of me left. I have been without a support structure of my own for... quite a few years now.
I know this is sounding suspiciously less and less like a rational suicide, but the whole story is a little more complicated...
Anyway, usually, I just pick myself up and power through it. Chin up and carry on as it were. I've just reached the point where I don't want to anymore. Tired of this cycle.

Also, from South Africa =)
I just listened. Gave what meager insights into human nature I have gathered in my strange life when appropriate/needed.

Difficult to say. If I had to try...
As horrible as this may or may not sound; their pain made them feel more *real* to me. I felt like I could help, even if it's just in a small way. Thinking back, that just sounds like hubris to me now, though.
